releaseNotes:
CantosTV v1.5.8

- The keyboard now opens automatically when you tap Search.
- Video now pauses when you leave the app and continues where you left off
  when you come back (it no longer keeps playing in the background).
- Recommended titles ("Because you watched") open on top, so Back returns to
  the title you opened first.
- The Trailer button lets you choose which YouTube app to use when you have
  more than one, and opens directly when you only have one.
- Search remembers your recent searches — tap one to repeat it, ✕ to remove a
  single entry, or Clear all to wipe the list.
